title: Third-party risk bundle
description: Vendor risk assessment and invoice evidence for a governed third-party decision.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: WorkflowBundle
metadata:
  name: fs-third-party-risk
  title: Third-party risk bundle
  description: Vendor risk assessment and invoice evidence for a governed third-party decision.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  workflowRef: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-cross-05
  ontology:
    ref: ladder://ontologies/builtin/financial-services
    mode: sliver
    selection:
      propertyRefs: [third_party_risk.criticality_tier, third_party_risk.information_security_rating, payment_obligation.vendor_name, payment_obligation.invoice_number]
      relationshipIds: [evaluates, owes]
  forms:
    - { ref: ladder://forms/docubricks/fs/third_party_risk_assessment, role: review }
  documents:
    - { ref: ladder://documents/docubricks/fs/invoice, role: supporting }
